Welcome to physiorehab.com on You Tube! This is where you can get the most effective FREE Physiotherapy rehabilitation exercises, advice and education videos for injuries, surgery, strengthening + mobility.

We specialise in the rehabilitation of injuries and surgery for the fitness enthusiast, endurance athlete and sports person, enabling them with a successful recovery and return to exercise. 

Learn from Principal Physiotherapist and educator Tim Keeley on the latest techniques, cueing and instruction to help you get your rehab done right. Stay tuned by subscribing to get the latest videos as they are uploaded.

Head to physiorehab.com for our online injury and surgery rehabilitation programs or if you need a clinic or telehealth appointment, jump over to our clinic page at physiofitness.com.au

We also have an exclusive Membership to "The Exercise Library", where there are new exercise instruction-specific videos being release every week. Hit the Join Now tab for more!
